title: Grade 2 Math — Thu, Jun 04
description: 3D Solid Shapes — Day 4 of 5: Solids in real life
subject: mathematics

questions.question: A football is shaped like a ___.
questions.explanation: A football is round all over — a sphere.

questions.question: A cardboard box for shoes is a ___.
questions.explanation: A shoe box has rectangular flat faces — a cuboid.

questions.question: A traffic cone on the road is shaped like a ___.
questions.explanation: It is wide at the base and pointed at the top — a cone.

questions.question: A water pipe is the shape of a ___.
questions.explanation: A pipe is long and round — a cylinder.

questions.question: A Rubik's cube is a ___.
questions.explanation: It has 6 equal square faces — a cube.

questions.question: An orange is closest to which shape?
questions.explanation: An orange is round like a ball — a sphere.

questions.question: A drum is most like a ___.
questions.explanation: A drum has round flat ends and a curved side — a cylinder.

questions.question: A dice and a sugar cube are both ___.
questions.explanation: Both have 6 equal square faces — cubes.

questions.question: A party hat is shaped like a ___.
questions.explanation: A party hat narrows to a point — a cone.

questions.question: A book is closest to which solid?
questions.explanation: A thick book is box-shaped with rectangular faces — a cuboid.

questions.question: A marble is shaped like a ___.
questions.explanation: A marble is a tiny ball — a sphere.

questions.question: A candle (the straight kind) is most like a ___.
questions.explanation: A straight candle is long and round — a cylinder.

questions.question: A gift wrapped in a square box is a ___.
questions.explanation: If all sides are equal squares, it is a cube.

questions.question: Which object is NOT a sphere?
questions.explanation: A tin can is a cylinder; the others are round spheres.

questions.question: Which pair are both cuboids?
questions.explanation: A brick and a matchbox are both box-shaped cuboids.
